precedence: Capture beats brief, brief beats plan. docs/wire-format.md outranks the build briefs on any question of what a server returns; the briefs outrank this file. This file is an index, not a specification. If something is unresolved, stop and ask rather than guessing.

tasks.title: v0.0 Pre-flight API verification & docs/wire-format.md
subtasks: TASK-v0.0-1: Capture /api/front, /api/new, /api/citizens, /api/events?kind=moderation into testdata

TASK-v0.0-2: Capture /api/post/:id in full — the comment object field names, types, nullability, parent_id at top level, and whether depth is 0- or 1-indexed. This capture is the specification for v0.1
TASK-v0.0-3: Capture a mod_state post verbatim, a 4xx error body, a 404, and a malformed request; record whether unauthenticated reads are rate limited
TASK-v0.0-4: Register a throwaway citizen; record the exact field name of the secret in the response
TASK-v0.0-5: Capture /api/me?since= in full — response shape, accepted since format, semantics of the four inbox bucket totals
TASK-v0.0-6: Confirm in upstream source (read, do not test) that a bare /api/me writes last_seen_at
TASK-v0.0-7: Determine whether inbox detail endpoints exist at all — v0.3 renders counts-only if they do not
TASK-v0.0-8: Capture POST /api/rotate field names, whether chain_head is returned, and confirm a key_rotation row appears in the public event log
TASK-v0.0-9: Provoke a 409 duplicate and record the body, so 409 and 429 can be told apart. Do NOT spend the daily post proving the 429
TASK-v0.0-10: GitHub fact 1 — confirm a bad token returns 404 not 403 on a private repo, tested with a token scoped to a different repo
TASK-v0.0-11: GitHub fact 2 — confirm Accept: application/vnd.github.raw returns bytes not JSON on a private repo

TASK-v0.0-12: GitHub fact 3 — determine what permissions.push actually reports (token access vs user access), tested with a Contents:Read-only token on an owned repo. If it reports user access, v0.2's pre-write check is a false green
TASK-v0.0-13: GitHub fact 4 — exact name of the fine-grained PAT expiration header and whether it appears on every response
TASK-v0.0-14: GitHub fact 5 — conflict status on a stale sha (409 vs 422) and the body; also record the PUT request shape (base64 content, message, sha)
TASK-v0.0-15: Benchmark Argon2id m=262144 t=3 p=1 on amd64 and arm64; record wall time and peak RSS; write down the memory floor for the README
TASK-v0.0-16: Confirm published-port behaviour — a container binding 127.0.0.1 internally is unreachable through -p; one binding 0.0.0.0 is reachable only on the published interface

TASK-v0.0-17: Write docs/wire-format.md — one section per endpoint with captured body, field table, and a 'what this means for the client' note. Where a finding contradicts a brief, say so explicitly: the finding wins

tasks.title: v0.1 Read-only 1f916 Board Client
subtasks: TASK-v0.1-1: Create the full repository layout including directories empty until later stages; go.mod; cmd/client/main.go; config incl. LOG_LEVEL
TASK-v0.1-2: Implement internal/f916 from the captured shapes in docs/wire-format.md, with explicit http.Client timeouts and io.LimitReader at 8 MiB
TASK-v0.1-3: Implement routes /, /new, /post/{id}, /post/{id}/thread/{comment_id}, /citizens with ?since=, /events, /static/{file}, /healthz, and /favicon.ico returning 204
TASK-v0.1-4: Comment tree building — cap render at 1000, drop unresolvable parent_id, bound recursion so a cycle cannot hang the process; indent three levels then link out to the thread route

TASK-v0.1-5: Rendering rules — escaped plain text, links split in Go with destination host shown, rel=noopener noreferrer nofollow, author_model never badge-styled, front page order preserved with pinned hoisted only if the server has not
TASK-v0.1-6: Security headers with script-src 'none' and connect-src 'none'; NO style= attribute anywhere including identicon SVGs — use fill/stroke presentation attributes
TASK-v0.1-7: Inline SVG identicons — sha256(handle), geometric only, palette-locked, aria-hidden
TASK-v0.1-8: Karma toggle as a cookie-flipping link (no JS), directory cached process-wide for 10 minutes, em dash for handles beyond the first 1000 — never a plausible zero
TASK-v0.1-9: UTC timestamps with relative form; import _ "time/tzdata" because distroless ships no zoneinfo

TASK-v0.1-10: Implement the design language from the brief — one hand-written stylesheet, no framework, max three elevation levels, no animation beyond 150ms state transitions, visible focus rings, prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-color-scheme
TASK-v0.1-11: Dev Dockerfile and host isolation test. This Dockerfile is superseded at v1.0 — do not maintain two

tasks.title: v0.2 Identity, the Vault, and the Two Tokens
subtasks: TASK-v0.2-1: Derivation with exact constants — password used exactly as typed with NO trimming and NO Unicode normalisation; HKDF with nil salt and L=32; [:32] slices the hex string not the bytes; email lowercased and trimmed before hashing
TASK-v0.2-2: Serialise derivations behind a mutex (256 MiB each); commit golden vectors, noting they defend against drift but not against a misreading today
TASK-v0.2-3: AES-256-GCM blob, AAD 1f916-vault-v1, fresh IV per write, padded so the WHOLE JSON document is exactly 512 bytes — build, measure, size pad, assert
TASK-v0.2-4: Versioned locator search (v2 then v1, re-wrap at the new locator, verify read-back, delete old). The header cannot solve migration because the locator derives from the parameters

TASK-v0.2-5: GitHub store client — raw read, PUT with base64 content plus message plus sha, one fixed commit message string naming no locator or handle or size class, conflict handling for BOTH 409 and 422
TASK-v0.2-6: Repo probe and 404 disambiguation. Never show 'wrong password' when the cause is a bad token

TASK-v0.2-7: Two-token model — read token from env or login field; write token NEVER in env, disk, config or vault; per-session dialog raised only by the six documented writes and nothing else; requires Contents:Read-write plus Metadata:Read
TASK-v0.2-8: permissions.push check, trusted only as far as TASK-v0.0-12 allows. If it reports user access, keep the 404 branch, drop the permission message, let the failed write be the defence
TASK-v0.2-9: Registration in the nine-step order — probe BEFORE the locator-free check, and seed decoys BEFORE the first real blob. Both orderings are load-bearing

TASK-v0.2-10: Orphan raw-key screen when the vault PUT fails after /api/register succeeded — held in memory, displayed until acknowledged. This is a v0.2 screen, distinct from the v0.4 rotation screen
TASK-v0.2-11: Sixteen decoys as STRUCTURALLY VALID blobs, not random bytes — well-formed envelope, fresh IV, random ciphertext, both 512 B and 4 KiB size classes

TASK-v0.2-12: Recovery file — two doors over the same plaintext with separate fresh IVs, AAD 1f916-recovery-v1, password door re-derives from the embedded email, escrow door is HKDF over the base32-decoded 256-bit code with no slow KDF, never written to disk server-side, export blocking at registration
TASK-v0.2-13: Document and enforce what a recovery-file session can do (read, post, comment, vote, flag) and cannot (drafts sync, password change, rotation)
TASK-v0.2-14: Session management — one unlocked identity per container, 30-minute idle lock, CSRF token in every form, Host allowlisting and Origin checks per the standing rules
TASK-v0.2-15: Implement the guardrails as explicit non-features and review against the do-not-build list before closing the stage

tasks.title: v0.3 Compose, Daily Quotas, and Drafts
subtasks: TASK-v0.3-1: Always pass ?since= to /api/me. Keep last_seen in the session, initialised to citizen_since, advanced ONLY when the inbox is opened; budget-only calls pass it unchanged
TASK-v0.3-2: Compose screen with a confirm step that carries new information and exactly two buttons; budget shown only from a server value, never computed
TASK-v0.3-3: Persist the draft to DRAFTS_DIR and flush BEFORE the request is built
TASK-v0.3-4: Never trust a 429 — re-read posts_remaining and report the server's number. No near-duplicate pre-check
TASK-v0.3-5: NEVER retry a write automatically, including when no response arrived. Re-read /api/me?since= and /api/me/history instead. Comments have no duplicate protection and a budget of 20
TASK-v0.3-6: Post, comment, vote, flag with the citizen key. Board reads continue to carry NO Authorization header; only /api/me and /api/me/history do
TASK-v0.3-7: Comment depth from docs/wire-format.md indexing; hide the reply control at the last permitted level rather than sending a POST that will fail
TASK-v0.3-8: Inbox shows counts only unless v0.0 found a real detail route. Never reconstruct a list from history. Do not poll

TASK-v0.3-9: Local drafts encrypted at rest under draft_key with AAD 1f916-drafts-v1, one file per draft at 0600, atomic temp-and-rename; unwritable DRAFTS_DIR warns and falls back to memory rather than refusing to start

TASK-v0.3-10: Optional repo sync — 4 KiB size class, union merge on id, last write wins on updated_at, conflict on 409 or 422; settings row states that every save is a commit with a permanent timestamp

TASK-v0.3-11: Lock ordering exactly — serialise, encrypt, zero the citizen key, upload, zero the write token. If the idle lock fires with sync on but no write token this session, keep the draft in upload-ready form and sync next session
TASK-v0.3-12: Logout with an unsaved draft — sync if on, drop if off, no modal; the warning lives in the button label

tasks.title: v0.4 Profile, Rotation, and Logout
subtasks: TASK-v0.4-1: Profile view with identity, karma, quota and settings
TASK-v0.4-2: Key rotation — 5-per-day cap, POST /api/rotate, vault re-wrap, verified read-back
TASK-v0.4-3: Rotation failure fallback — raw new key displayed until acknowledged, surviving refresh from MEMORY only and never written to disk

TASK-v0.4-4: Password change moves BOTH the vault and drafts blobs — write both, verify both read back, then delete both. Never delete first. A failed drafts move does not roll back the password change
TASK-v0.4-5: Recovery file checker, password door re-deriving from the embedded email
TASK-v0.4-6: Logout — zero the citizen key and write token, sync or drop the draft per the v0.3 rule

tasks.title: v1.0 Docker, CI/CD Actions, and Documentation
subtasks: TASK-v1.0-1: Dockerfile — golang:1.25-alpine build stage and gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12 runtime, both digest-pinned; CGO_ENABLED=0, -mod=vendor -trimpath -ldflags -s -w; USER 65532:65532
TASK-v1.0-2: Create /data in the build stage and COPY it with --chown=65532:65532 — a volume on a path absent from the image arrives root-owned and distroless has no shell to fix it
TASK-v1.0-3: ENV LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8080 and DRAFTS_DIR=/data; commit a .dockerignore covering .git, docs/, *.md and local scratch
TASK-v1.0-4: Release workflow on v* tags with every action pinned by commit SHA — resolve the real SHAs, the briefs carry placeholders
TASK-v1.0-5: Add a test job that publish depends on — gofmt -l, go vet, go test ./... including golden vectors, and an offline -mod=vendor build so drifted vendoring fails in CI
TASK-v1.0-6: Gate the latest tag on the ref containing no hyphen, so a release candidate does not become latest
TASK-v1.0-7: Multi-arch amd64 and arm64 with provenance and SBOM; id-token and attestations permissions present; no personal access token

TASK-v1.0-8: README, one screen, eight items — including Metadata:Read on the PAT, that drafts on the volume are encrypted, no password reset, the gh attestation verify line, the measured memory floor, and why every run command uses -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080
TASK-v1.0-9: Execute the release checklist and every earlier stage's acceptance criteria, v0.0 included
